Enrich person.title: Interim Vice President, Customer Service Delivery
Enrich person.summary:
As General Manager of Customer Solutions Delivery with TELUS, I connect with municipalities, customers and key influencers in an effort to drive better human outcomes for communities across Vancouver Island.

Our dedicated team of Technicians and Community & Service Excellence Managers are the face of TELUS in our communities, no matter how big or small. They work tirelessly to deliver unparalleled experiences to customers across our internet, TV, smart security and automation services.

I’m incredibly proud of how our TELUS team members are rooted in giving back to the communities where we live, work and serve and I truly believe healthy and vibrant communities are synergistic with healthy and vibrant businesses operating in those communities.   

Exuberant learner/reader.  Committed exercise/spin class enthusiast.  Quaint coffee shop enthusiast.
Enrich person.headline: Shaye Draper

education.field_of_study: Wood Science and Wood Products/Pulp and Paper Technology

experience.title: Interim Vice President, Customer Service Delivery
experience.summary:
Leading the delivery of 1M+ technician visits annually across Alberta and British Columbia, driving operational excellence and service quality for TELUS Consumer Solutions’ fastest-growing sales channel. Responsible for optimizing processes, reducing repeat visits, and ensuring outstanding customer experiences.

Empowering high-performing teams — both internal and partner technicians — through mentorship, collaboration, and a culture of accountability. Focused on delivering measurable impact for customers and communities while promoting innovation, continuous improvement, and operational efficiency.

experience.title: Director Business Strategy
experience.summary:
As a strategic leader within the Customer Service Excellence (CSE) team, I spearhead the development and execution of transformative initiatives that elevate organizational performance and customer experience. My role synthesizes visionary thinking with pragmatic implementation, leveraging robust program management and performance analytics to drive measurable results.

In this pivotal position, I serve three key functions:

Strategic Visionary: I challenge conventional thinking and craft innovative strategies that push boundaries and achieve ambitious outcomes. By maintaining a holistic perspective, I identify opportunities for growth and improvement across the organization.

Executive Air Traffic Controller: With a forward-thinking approach, I enhance leadership team visibility on critical priorities, ensuring seamless alignment between corporate objectives and business unit initiatives. My strategic sequencing of programs optimizes resource allocation and drives timely, impactful results.

Leadership Catalyst: As an extension of the CSE leadership team, I orchestrate strategic initiatives that span our business unit. This encompasses managing annual planning cycles, overseeing budget allocation, and guiding headcount governance. By adeptly navigating matrix relationships, I foster leadership alignment and drive consistent business outcomes.

Through this multifaceted approach, I enable our organization to anticipate market shifts, capitalize on emerging opportunities, and consistently deliver exceptional value to our customers and stakeholders.
